title: Grateful Dead Live at Piedmont Park on 1969-07-07
lineage: Dat (Tascam DA-20) -> Tascam SS-R05 -> Samplitude Professional v11.2.1 -> FLAC

ai_review.summary: Excellent summer‑’69 soundboard captures a high‑energy Dead show highlighted by Dark Star → St. Stephen → Eleven and a soaring Lovelight.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised as one of the better soundboards from Summer ’69, offering crisp clarity throughout. The performance shines with a top‑drawer Dark Star into St. Stephen and Eleven sequence, plus an inspired Tom Constanten organ on Lovelight, making it a standout show despite some confusion about Allman Brothers’ participation.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high reviewer scores (mostly 5‑star) and strong praise for both the musical set and the soundboard quality outweigh a single low‑rating outlier.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp, clear mix; described as one of the better summer ’69 soundboards. No dropout or major flaws reported.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The set flows strongly with a powerful Dark Star → St. Stephen → Eleven suite, highlighted organ work from Tom Constanten, and an uplifting Lovelight that closed the show on a high note.

band_member_comments.Jerry: No specific musical comment, but reviewers noted being up close to Jerry, indicating strong stage presence.
band_member_comments.Keys: Tom Constanten's organ performance was singled out as a reason for his inclusion in the band.
band_member_comments.Drums: The finale featuring drums earned audience applause; the rhythm section received positive remarks.
